name: bp-sov
description: Counts share of voice for a brand against its named competitors over a time window. Pure counting: no LLM call, no network call, no database read. Input is a SOVInput, output is one application/json artifact holding a ShareOfVoice.

skills.name: Share of voice
skills.description: Given enriched mentions and a brand profile, returns the brand's percentage share of conversation against each competitor named in the profile, broken down per source. Mentions about neither the brand nor a listed competitor are excluded from the denominator rather than counted for the brand.
examples: Compute share of voice for brand_id brd_01J against its competitors over the last 24 hours.
